title: [United Nations forces Korea 1957, 1958]
summary: Korea circa 1957-1958. [Reel 1]. Parade at a British Armoured unit with crews and Centurion tanks featured. Parade of United Nations forces at a military base. Flags indicate US, Greek, British and Turkish forces present. 'SAC Library' sign in the background. 'US 8th Army Band' on the side of the bass drum of the military band. Fly past of a formation of Sabre jets. An outdoor party with food cook
